description: ADR-0123 D4 example pool for the selector retrieval experiment. Hand-written paraphrases in the PromptExample shape; placeholders only (ABC-123, #channel-a, <person>, user@example.com, https://example.invalid/...); disjoint from every gold corpus (n-gram lint, embedding audit). Drafted by the agent without reading the gold files; each batch needs the owner's approval before any plan may use it. No learning_items row or LRN export may become an entry.
